response.text:
{
  "obligations": [
    {
      "text": "The Internal Ombudsman (IO) shall be designated as a permanent invitee to the meetings of the Customer Service Committee of the Board.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "designate IO as permanent invitee to Customer Service Committee meetings",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "13(1)",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "In banks having multiple IOs, the Customer Service Committee shall decide to have representation of more than one IO or a system of rotation.",
      "actor": "Customer Service Committee of the Board",
      "action": "decide on multiple IO representation or rotation",
      "condition": "banks having multiple IOs",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "13(1)",
      "severity": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "The IO shall furnish periodic reports, including analysis of complaints, to the Customer Service Committee of the Board, preferably quarterly but not less often than half‑yearly.",
      "actor": "IO",
      "action": "furnish periodic reports with complaint analysis",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "quarterly preferred; at least half‑yearly",
      "source_ref": "13(2)",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The decision of the IO or Deputy IO can be overruled only with the approval of the Competent Authority.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "obtain Competent Authority approval before overruling IO/Dy. IO decision",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "13(3)",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "All cases where the IO/Dy. IO decision has been overruled by the Competent Authority shall be placed before the Customer Service Committee of the Board for review.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "place overruled cases before Customer Service Committee for review",
      "condition": "when decision is overruled by Competent Authority",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "13(4)",
      "severity": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "Information on complaints resolved by the RBI Ombudsman in favour of the complainant shall be placed before the Customer Service Committee of the Board on a quarterly basis, accompanied by analysis of the top five complaint categories and remedial measures.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "present quarterly information and analysis of RBI Ombudsman‑favoured complaints",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "quarterly",
      "source_ref": "13(5)",
      "severity": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "The bank shall put in place a fully automated Complaints Management System and provide access to the IO/Dy. IO.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "implement automated Complaints Management System and grant IO/Dy. IO access",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "14(1)",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "All complaints partially resolved or wholly rejected by the bank's internal grievance mechanism shall be auto‑escalated to the IO for review.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "auto‑escalate such complaints to IO",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "14(1)",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "For complaints with RBI, NPCI or card‑network prescribed resolution timelines, the bank shall ensure the IO/Dy. IO receives at least 10 days for review to enable final decision within the prescribed timelines.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "provide IO/Dy. IO at least 10 days review time for such complaints",
      "condition": "complaints with external prescribed timelines",
      "deadline": "at least 10 days before external deadline",
      "source_ref": "14(1)",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "For all other complaints, the bank shall ensure the IO/Dy. IO reviews them within 20 days of receipt.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "ensure IO/Dy. IO review within 20 days",
      "condition": "other complaints",
      "deadline": "20 days from receipt",
      "source_ref": "14(1)",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The bank shall provide only three categories—'Fully Resolved', 'Partially Resolved' and 'Wholly Rejected'—in its Complaint Management System for recording decisions before escalation to the IO.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "limit classification to three categories",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "14(2)",
      "severity": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "The bank shall formulate a Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for the flow of complaints and information in a time‑bound manner.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "formulate SOP for complaint flow",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "14(3)",
      "severity": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "A complaint must not be closed by the same branch/unit/other touch point that resolved or rejected it; it must be reviewed at a senior level before being sent to the IO.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "prevent same branch/unit from closing complaint; require senior‑level review before IO escalation",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "14(4)",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The bank shall forward all rejected or partially resolved complaints of the categories listed in 14(5)(a) and (b) to the IO/Dy. IO for assessment of inherent service deficiency.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "forward such complaints to IO/Dy. IO",
      "condition": "complaints in categories (a) and (b) of 14(5)",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "14(5)",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "Complaints that are outside the purview of these Directions shall be immediately returned to the bank by the IO/Dy. IO.",
      "actor": "IO/Dy. IO",
      "action": "return out‑of‑scope complaints to bank",
      "condition": "complaint outside purview",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "14(5)",
      "severity": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "The IO/Dy. IO shall examine complaints based on bank records, complainant documents, and bank comments.",
      "actor": "IO/Dy. IO",
      "action": "examine complaints using available records and documents",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "14(6)",
      "severity": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "The IO/Dy. IO may hold meetings with concerned bank functionaries and seek additional records necessary for examining the complaint.",
      "actor": "IO/Dy. IO",
      "action": "hold meetings and request additional records",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "14(7)",
      "severity": "low"
    },
    {
      "text": "The IO/Dy. IO may seek written or oral submissions from the complainant through the secretariat if necessary.",
      "actor": "IO/Dy. IO",
      "action": "seek additional information from complainant",
      "condition": "if necessary",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "14(8)",
      "severity": "low"
    },
    {
      "text": "The bank shall ensure that the final decision is communicated to the complainant within 30 days from the date of receipt of the complaint.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "communicate final decision to complainant",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "30 days from receipt",
      "source_ref": "14(9)",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The IO/Dy. IO shall record a reasoned decision in each case.",
      "actor": "IO/Dy. IO",
      "action": "record reasoned decision",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "14(10)",
      "severity": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "When the IO/Dy. IO upholds the bank's decision to reject or partially resolve a complaint, the reply to the complainant shall explicitly state that the complaint was reviewed by the IO/Dy. IO.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "state IO/Dy. IO review in reply",
      "condition": "IO/Dy. IO upholds bank's decision",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "14(11)",
      "severity": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "For complaints partially resolved or wholly rejected after IO/Dy. IO examination, the bank shall advise the complainant of the option to approach the RBI Ombudsman, provide complete complaint details, and include the RBI Complaint Management System URL and the Centralised Receipt and Processing Centre address.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "advise complainant of Ombudsman option and provide details",
      "condition": "complaint partially resolved or wholly rejected after IO/Dy. IO review",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "14(12)",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "When a complaint is escalated to the RBI Ombudsman, the bank shall include the IO/Dy. IO's decision in the information submitted to the Ombudsman; if the complaint was not previously reviewed, the bank shall obtain the IO/Dy. IO's comments and submit them.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "include IO/Dy. IO decision or obtain comments for Ombudsman submission",
      "condition": "complaint escalated to RBI Ombudsman",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "14(13)",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The bank shall use the analysis of complaints handled by the IO/Dy. IO in training programmes or conferences to raise awareness among frontline staff about complaint patterns, root causes and remedial measures.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "incorporate IO/Dy. IO complaint analysis into staff training",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "14(14)",
      "severity": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "The Customer Service Committee of the Board shall analyse the number of cases where the IO/Dy. IO decision differs substantively from the RBI Ombudsman decision when assessing IO/Dy. IO performance.",
      "actor": "Customer Service Committee of the Board",
      "action": "analyse substantive differences between IO/Dy. IO and Ombudsman decisions",
      "condition": "during IO/Dy. IO performance assessment",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "14(15)",
      "severity": "medium"
    }]}
